# npm — plain, versioned, flagged, scoped, multi-package, global
npm install express
npm i lodash@4.17.21
npm install --save-dev typescript
npm add -D vitest@^2.1.8
npm install @babel/core @babel/preset-env
npm i -g nodemon
npm install chalk boxen

# pip / uv / poetry — plain, pinned, extras+range, and non-package directives to skip
pip install requests
pip install requests==2.31.0
pip install "requests[socks]>=2.31,<3"
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -e .
uv add httpx
uv pip install rich==13.7.0
poetry add fastapi
poetry add "uvicorn[standard]@^0.30.0"
poetry add requests@^2.31.0

# Maven — dependency:get coordinate syntax, with and without packaging
mvn dependency:get -Dartifact=com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.17.0
mvn dependency:get -Dartifact=org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.14.0:jar

# Maven — pasted dependency blocks (e.g. copied from a POM into a chat/terminal)
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.springframework</groupId>
  <artifactId>spring-core</artifactId>
  <version>6.1.5</version>
</dependency>
<dependency>
  <groupId>junit</groupId>
  <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
  <version>4.13.2</version>
</dependency>
